summary: En Nahud Airport (NUD/HSNH) is a small regional airport serving the town of En Nahud in the West Kordofan state of central Sudan. The facility primarily supports domestic connectivity, serving the local community and limited general aviation traffic in this semi-arid region. With its modest infrastructure, the airport plays a vital role in connecting remote parts of Kordofan to larger Sudanese urban centers.
faqs:
Q: What is the IATA code for En Nahud Airport?
A: The IATA code is NUD, and the ICAO code is HSNH.

Q: What kind of airport is En Nahud?
A: It is classified as a small airport, primarily handling domestic and general aviation flights.

Q: Where is En Nahud located?
A: En Nahud is situated in West Kordofan state in central Sudan, an area characterized by semi-arid landscapes.

Q: Does En Nahud Airport serve international flights?
A: No, it primarily handles domestic flights and is not equipped for large international operations.
transport_tips: Ground transportation to and from En Nahud Airport is typically arranged through local taxis or private vehicles, as there is no formal public transit link. Travelers should arrange transport in advance, as on-demand options can be limited in this remote area. The airport is located near the town center, so journey times are generally short.
local_tip: Carry plenty of drinking water and sun protection when traveling through En Nahud, as the surrounding Kordofan region experiences high temperatures and dry conditions for much of the year.
